notes: Rows use matching requested component formats; source and actual tensor types are separately recorded. HiFT always stores F32. Vision component export is F32.
CPU kernels use F32 accumulation, with weight-format-specific prepared input QDQ. Thinker KV F32/F16 and talker KV F32 are separate from weight storage.
Auto is implemented through shared dispatch but actual CPU/GPU execution and submission counts must be measured per entrypoint; an Auto fallback is not GPU support.
Entrypoint states identify their measured artifact in entrypoint-results.json; they are functional checks, distinct from component numerical acceptance. Untested combinations remain not run.
Unimplemented resident K-format decoder integration is distinct from implemented-but-failed thinker numerical contracts. Remaining layers are specified in validation.md.

The earlier claim that shared Qwen3-VL/DeepStack Vulkan support was absent is corrected: the current shared decoder already implements it. Actual model/backend validation is still required; audio and HiFT components now have separately validated mixed device paths.

Grouped CLI text/image/audio reuses the shared grouped core and configured resident runtime. HTTP grouped audio now has /v1/jev/audio_grouped with multi_select/block_choice, bounded decoding and the resident scorer. The existing single /v1/jev/audio schema is retained. Local handler tests do not establish matching-format model matrix passes; mixed-format runs are separate.

Historical mmproj-F32.gguf stored F32 but used Q8-prepacked aligned linears and dynamic Q8 inputs, with F32 fallback for the 4304-wide FFN-down input. Those image entrypoint passes retain that identity; the later lossless nine-check suite below supersedes the earlier pending entrypoint note.

Mixed-format audio/S2S measurements have separate rows and do not establish an all-Q8 component configuration. Prior Auto CPU fallback used the older width-cap gate; the reviewed strict device run reaches Vulkan and fails the unchanged numerical model contract.

New vision-lossless-mmproj-F32.gguf explicitly sets boolean clip.vision.preserve_f32=true, preserving F32 linear weights/activations through the existing lossless path. Missing/false metadata and existing WeVisOne compatibility retain previous behavior. The 352 tensor payloads and original metadata match the historical asset.

Independent official Transformers 4.57.6 CPU/four-thread vision-only execution passes 32/32 checkpoints for the fixed red image, with unchanged F32 gates rRMSE <= 0.001 and cosine >= 0.999999. Direct encoder checks do not establish new lossless CLI/HTTP or Auto/Vulkan acceptance. Vision tower rows use kv=none because the encoder has no KV cache.

The historical Sophon shared-default vision asset has identical projected and three DeepStack plane hashes before/after the opt-in change. Other models' real vision assets were unavailable; their real vision regressions remain unverified.

Latest CPU image entrypoints use explicit clip.vision.preserve_f32=true, with Q8_0 thinker/F16 KV. All nine checks pass, including CLI/HTTP probability equality. The direct independent vision Oracle passes 32/32; combined-model numerical/task-quality acceptance remains separate.

Final Auto text HTTP and CLI fallback checks pass after real device submissions. A genuine second-chunk device loss in 68-token HTTP JEV now replays the entire current input and matches CPU probabilities exactly; original pre-fix difference 0.02338428422808647 is retained. Strict Vulkan numerical failure remains a separate failed acceptance row.

Replacement host 31344 mixed Q6_K thinker/F32 audio CPU checks pass CLI/HTTP single, block_choice and default multi_select with zero probability differences; seven invalid HTTP requests return 400. These two mixed rows do not mark any matching-format, Auto, Vulkan, task-quality or failed Q6 numerical row passed.

2026-11-19 M3 Max update: audio, Talker projection offload, Flow and HiFT now have explicit mixed Vulkan paths. Earlier missing-device statements are superseded for these components, not for resident K-format thinker support.

F16 Flow now explicitly retains F32 activation/accumulation on CPU and GPU. Its old rounded-activation GPU failure remains recorded; the matching existing F32-activation Oracle passes without changing the gate.
Component encoder/Flow/HiFT rows now use kv=none because they have no KV cache; combined thinker rows retain their decoder KV restriction. Talker offload explicitly preserves F32 KV.

All 81 matching-format component combinations were executed. F32/F16/BF16 pass all 27 component gates; only two other combinations pass. Short Flow and HiFT fixtures are independent inputs, not the connected synthesis pipeline. After convolution review, F32/F16 nonstream waveform gates still fail; BF16 nonstream and all three stream comparisons pass on one short input. Component acceptance never overrides a failed full-pipeline gate.

New mixed Q4_0 thinker/F32 audio/F16-KV rows are separate from matching-format component rows. CLI/HTTP agree within each backend; CPU/Auto audio JEV probabilities fail the unchanged 1e-7 comparison despite matching choice, text and token IDs. Original Auto CLI JSON pollution is retained as a RED record and repaired/retested separately.
